note: The PINWHEEL DERIVATION (not just validity): arrangement::cells derives EXACTLY the 5 pinwheel cells from the 4-segment non-slicing bag, proving the union-find machinery handles a layout no BSP tree can express. Same bag as arrangement_valid/pinwheel.json: v@960 y[0,1200], v@1920 y[600,1800], h@600 x[960,2880], h@1200 x[0,1920] over a 2880x1800 canvas. The four arms pin a centre cell. cells() (sorted [frame.y, frame.x]) returns 5 FILLED rectangles: A=(0,0,960,1200) left, B=(960,0,1920,600) top, C=(960,600,960,600) CENTRE, D=(1920,600,960,1200) right, E=(0,1200,1920,600) bottom. Frames hand-computed on paper and cross-checked in experiments/line-model/arrangement.py BEFORE blessing (a wrong span would derive 4 or 6 cells). Cells carry the atom box (i0..j1, atoms) S2 will key identity on.
